title: Awake in a Dream
content: You guys!!! I'm so excited to present this album here!! Of all the places I'm promoting this, you are the only ones I really care hear this experience. Mallworld is a common setting for my dreams, and my dreams are my greatest muse. This album in particular had a lot of mallworld energy worked in. I'd say it's the main setting really. Headphones recommended, and a recliner, maybe some weed too hehe. Enjoy :)
